major_cooldowns.name: Army of the Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown and macro your on-use trinket, racial and potion to it, pairing it with every second Dark Transformation; it opens a 30 second Forbidden Knowledge window that turns Death Coil into Necrotic Coil and Epidemic into Graveyard.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 42650 is the cast id (6 casts sampled); 1242223 is the Forbidden Knowledge buff it grants, whose 30s duration is used here.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Transformation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it the moment it comes up on the 45 second cycle, entering the window with 6-8 stacks of Lesser Ghoul so the window is spent on Putrefy and Soul Reaper rather than on building with Festering Strike.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1233448 is the current cast id; 1235391 is the self aura and 63560 the legacy id.

major_cooldowns.name: Putrefy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Concentrate every charge inside Dark Transformation where Commander of the Dead buffs it, and sit on charges rather than spending them in the gap before the next window; above 35% health press it manually, below 35% let Soul Reaper trigger it.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Time it onto a known raid magic hit: it absorbs up to 30% of your maximum health in magic damage and converts the absorb into Runic Power, but on progression the mitigation comes first.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Use it for 30% damage reduction on heavy physical hits and for the stun immunity on scripted stun mechanics.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to break or pre-empt charm, fear and sleep effects, and for 6% extra Leech while it runs.

defensives.name: Death Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Emergency heal for a large chunk of maximum health; the healing absorb it leaves behind means you press it when you are about to die, not as a top-up.
defensives.id_note: 48743 is the classic Death Pact talent cast; 443609 is a lower-value variant with the same name. Verify which one Unholy fires if casts go unmatched.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it under the raid for a scheduled magic burst; it cuts magic damage taken by 15% for everyone standing in it.
defensives.id_note: 51052 is the talented cast id (4 min cooldown); 145629 is the aura seen in the parse.

rules.description: Open Outbreak, Festering Strike, Army, Dark Transformation
rules.action: Open with Outbreak, then 2x Festering Strike, then Army of the Dead plus Dark Transformation with trinket, racial and potion macroed in, then start dumping Putrefy charges.

rules.description: Army of the Dead paired with Dark Transformation
rules.action: Send Dark Transformation with every Army of the Dead. They align on a 45 second cycle, so Army goes out with every second Dark Transformation and any delay pushes the whole 90 second burst plan back.

rules.description: Putrefy charges spent inside Dark Transformation
rules.action: Hold Putrefy for Dark Transformation and empty your charges inside the window, where Commander of the Dead buffs them. Do not spend charges in the gap after the window ends, even sitting at 3 stacks.

Only press Soul Reaper during Dark Transformation: on the free Reaping cast, or on a target below 35% health. With Blightfall, hold it until roughly 5 seconds before the window ends so the plague damage debuff overlaps your Blightfall.

rules.description: Sudden Doom spent on Death Coil or Epidemic
rules.action: Spend Sudden Doom on sight with Death Coil, or Epidemic at 3+ targets. With Harbinger of Doom you may bank up to 2 charges, but never let one expire.

Track the Festering Scythe buff and refresh it with Festering Strike into Festering Scythe the moment it drops; the normal priority does not maintain it on its own and Forbidden Knowledge proc rate scales with its uptime.

rules.description: Epidemic over Death Coil in AoE
rules.action: Swap your Runic Power spender from Death Coil to Epidemic at 3+ targets, and at 6+ targets while Forbidden Knowledge is up. Below that, Death Coil hits harder.

source_summary: Unholy stacks everything onto a 45 second cycle: Dark Transformation goes out the moment it is up, with Army of the Dead joining every second window along with trinket, racial and potion. Putrefy charges and Soul Reaper are concentrated inside those windows, where Commander of the Dead multiplies them, while Army opens a 30 second Forbidden Knowledge window that upgrades Death Coil into Necrotic Coil and Epidemic into Graveyard. Between windows the job is plague upkeep with Outbreak, active Festering Scythe maintenance, Lesser Ghoul stacks cycled between Festering Strike and Scourge Strike, and Sudden Doom procs spent before they expire.
